title: Mirabel and the Kitchen
author: Bram Montrose
blurb: Hazel Montrose, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
